site: Workday candidate account creation and sign-in (Analog Devices)
class: Account creation sign-in fallback paused by new-employer login route when allow_create is false
symptom: After successfully creating a new ATS account on Workday, the wizard stops with 'sign-in on <host> is paused to protect the account: No account is recorded for this employer, and this login page offers no usable registration path'.
root_cause: When Workday left registration and redirected to the Sign-In page, fill_create_account_form did not call remember_account before calling attempt_auto_login(..., create_if_missing=False). In attempt_auto_login, _new_employer_login_route saw that account_confirmed_absent was true and allow_create was false, and falsely asserted that the login page offered no usable registration path, pausing sign-in instead of allowing login with the newly created credentials.
why_tests_missed: Existing unverified sign-in tests (test_after_creating_the_account_it_signs_in_with_the_email_and_password) used a test assistant without a tracker attached, so account_confirmed_absent evaluated to false and bypassed _new_employer_login_route.
fix: 1. In browser_automation.py fill_create_account_form, call self.remember_account(page, email, 'password') as soon as account creation has completed so the new account is recorded on file. 2. In _new_employer_login_route, return None when allow_create is False so caller-directed sign-ins are not falsely blocked.
prevention: Ensure unit tests for authentication gateways run with a realistic mock tracker populated so account existence checks match production behaviour.
